baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun البحر at word 1 supplies the aqueous expanse, while المسجور at word 2 predicates a filled state of it.
baseline_models.mechanism: A wide body of water is brought to fullness, so the oath fixes attention on stored capacity and pressure rather than on an inert landscape.

activation_trace.role: Supplies broad abundant water as the material field of the model.
Supplies filling with water and makes plenitude the sea's operative condition.

changed_reading.before: A sea singled out by an opaque epithet.
changed_reading.after: A vast water body brought to charged fullness, with its stored capacity foregrounded.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same passive adjective المسجور can activate the branch in which sea water subsides or is emptied.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage plenitude's opposite: a broad sea disclosed through withdrawal, making absence and exposed capacity as live as fullness.

activation_trace.role: Keeps the referent a broad abundance of water against which recession is measurable.
Supplies draining or subsiding and reverses the expected filled-sea reading.

changed_reading.before: The epithet intensifies the amount of water.
changed_reading.after: The epithet may instead mark the sea at recession, with its emptied depth exposed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: المسجور directly carries a kindling branch while modifying the water-denoting البحر.
baseline_models.mechanism: Water and fire are forced into one object: the sea is not merely hot but converted into fuel or an ignited medium, an elemental reversal held inside the adjective.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the abundant water whose ordinary behavior makes ignition paradoxical.

changed_reading.after: An impossible-seeming sea whose waters have become an ignited or fire-bearing medium.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The breadth branch of البحر and the companionship-mingling branch of المسجور remain attached to the two focus words.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sea's magnitude can be modeled as a multitude constituted by intimate mixture, not only as a quantity of liquid; its expanse is relational density.

activation_trace.role: Supplies breadth and extension as the large field in which relations can spread.
Supplies affectionate companionship and mingling, turning mass into a social medium.

changed_reading.after: An expanse made large by the close mingling of many constituents or companions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A water-holding place branch of البحر combines with the collar or shackle branch of المسجور.
baseline_models.mechanism: The apparently boundless sea becomes a retained reservoir: capacity depends on a perimeter that holds, collars, or restrains what would otherwise escape.

activation_trace.role: Supplies ground or a hollow that gathers water, giving the sea a containing basin.

changed_reading.before: The sea is naturally and indefinitely open.
changed_reading.after: The sea is a deliberately held reservoir whose vast contents remain under restraint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: البحر supplies expanse while المسجور supplies abundant matter streaming, strung out, or scattering from a string.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus becomes a process rather than a static object: a broad field whose units can remain serially ordered or spill from their ordering line.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the breadth across which streaming or scattering can unfold.

changed_reading.after: A vast stream of units poised between serial arrangement and dispersal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding oath objects alternate limit, aligned inscription, opened spread, and overhead cover. That sequence revises the sea into a terminal cosmic container: broad contents are ordered like a line or sheet, held by a boundary, yet able to open and stream out.

changed_reading.before: A naturally bounded or streaming body of water.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses sea, color, spring, and gaze domains; it remains anchored in the focus branches for deep redness and color mixed in an eye, then gains context support from eye contrast, a water spring, and guarding eyes. Downstream prose should present it as an ocular-water analogy, not as a claim that البحر lexically means an eye.

strongest_changes: The immediate aftermath converts the focus's full, drained, and kindled branches into phases of irreversible cosmic pressure release.
The garden sequence preserves the same fullness and streaming as protected, rowed, portioned, and pearl-like abundance rather than destructive discharge.
Later relational language makes companionship-mingling and shackling coexist as collective attachment plus individual pledge, while طغيان makes restraint a live hydraulic and moral threshold.
Repeated تسبيح reopens the water image as a traversable rhythmic medium, so the sea remains dynamic after the judgment and discourse sequences.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots do not settle into one gloss: fullness and drainage, water and fire, companionship and shackle, ordered streaming and scattering remain simultaneous latent states. Context repeatedly activates these oppositions as mechanisms rather than resolving them.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether fullness, recession, and ignition are simultaneous facets, successive phases, or deliberately competing readings.
The oath architecture and streamed-discourse models depend on sequence-level analogy rather than explicit syntactic causation.
The ocular, acoustic, encounter, and later crisis-term activations should remain visibly exploratory even when their branch and context anchors are exact.
